title: Double-cone outer measure on directions: null off the axis set, and cap densities control the slab-cone conditions (Steps 1–3)
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, E := Rn N = ℝ^N, H ⊆ E a linear subspace with orthogonal projection p_H := H.starProjection, and S(H) := {ζ ∈ H : |ζ| = 1}. Let A ⊆ E be an arbitrary set, δ > 0, a ∈ E and Hⁿ := μHE[n]. For θ ∈ E and s > 0 let Z_θ(s) := {x : |p_H(x − a) − (p_H(x − a)·θ)θ| < s|p_H(x − a)|} and m′(θ, r, s) := Hⁿ(A ∩ (Z_θ(s) ∩ B(a, r))). Let Ax′(θ) mean that some b ∈ A has b ≠ a, dist(b, a) < δ and p_H(b − a) − (p_H(b − a)·θ)θ = 0. Then there is an outer measure m on E with the following properties. (i) m({θ ∈ S(H) : Ax′(θ) fails}) = 0. (ii) Let θ ∈ S(H). If for every c > 0 there is η > 0 with m(S(H) ∩ B(θ, t)) ≤ ctⁿ for all 0 < t < η, then for every c > 0 there is ε > 0 with m′(θ, r, s) ≤ c(rs)ⁿ for all 0 < s < ε and 0 < r < δ. If for every K ∈ ℝ and η > 0 there is 0 < t < η with Ktⁿ < m(S(H) ∩ B(θ, t)), then for every K ∈ ℝ and ε > 0 there are 0 < s < ε and 0 < r < δ with K(rs)ⁿ ≤ m′(θ, r, s). Numerical bounds are compared in [0, ∞] via ENNReal.ofReal, and B is the open ball.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (H : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)) (A : Set (Rn N)) (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → ∀ a : Rn N, ∃ m : OuterMeasure (Rn N), m {θ | θ ∈ H ∧ ‖θ‖ = 1 ∧ ¬ ∃ b ∈ A, b ≠ a ∧ dist b a < δ ∧ H.starProjection (b - a) - inner ℝ (H.starProjection (b - a)) θ • θ = 0} = 0 ∧ ∀ θ ∈ H, ‖θ‖ = 1 → ((∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < η → m ({ζ | ζ ∈ H ∧ ‖ζ‖ = 1} ∩ Metric.ball θ t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * t ^ n)) → ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < ε → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < δ → μHE[n] (A ∩ ({x | ‖H.starProjection (x - a) - inner ℝ (H.starProjection (x - a)) θ • θ‖ < s * ‖H.starProjection (x - a)‖} ∩ Metric.ball a r)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * (r * s) ^ n)) ∧ ((∀ K : ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ t < η ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (K * t ^ n) < m ({ζ | ζ ∈ H ∧ ‖ζ‖ = 1} ∩ Metric.ball θ t)) → ∀ K : ℝ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s < ε ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r < δ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (K * (r * s) ^ n) ≤ μHE[n] (A ∩ ({x | ‖H.starProjection (x - a) - inner ℝ (H.starProjection (x - a)) θ • θ‖ < s * ‖H.starProjection (x - a)‖} ∩ Metric.ball a r)))
